prompt: Write a script for a YouTube video made by a 12 year-old boy named Theo. They video should be called "How to put on a wetsuit".
response:
Sure! Here's a simple script for Theo's YouTube video titled "How to put on a wetsuit":

---

**[Opening Scene]**

**Theo:** (smiling) "Hey everyone, it's Theo here! Today, I'm going to show you how to put on a wetsuit. Whether you're going surfing, diving, or just playing in the water, a wetsuit can keep you warm and comfortable. So, let's get started!"

**[Cut to Theo standing next to a wetsuit]**

**Theo:** "First, let's talk about the different parts of a wetsuit. There's the torso, the legs, and the arms. Some wetsuits also have a hood and booties. For this video, I'll be showing you how to put on a full wetsuit."

**[Cut to Theo sitting down and starting to put on the wetsuit]**

**Theo:** "Step one: Start by putting your feet into the legs of the wetsuit. Make sure you pull them up as high as you can. It might feel a bit tight, but that's okay. The tighter it is, the better it will keep you warm."

**[Cut to Theo pulling the wetsuit legs up]**

**Theo:** "Step two: Next, put your arms into the sleeves. Again, pull them up as high as you can. It's okay if it feels a bit snug. This is where you might need a little help from a friend or a parent."

**[Cut to Theo pulling the wetsuit sleeves up]**

**Theo:** "Step three: Now, it's time to pull the wetsuit over your head. This can be a bit tricky, so you might want to ask someone to help you. Make sure you pull it up over your head and onto your shoulders."

**[Cut to Theo pulling the wetsuit over his head]**

**Theo:** "Step four: Once you have the wetsuit on, you'll want to make sure it's all the way up your arms and legs. If you have any extra material, tuck it in so it's not loose. This will help keep the water out and the warmth in."

**[Cut to Theo adjusting the wetsuit]**

**Theo:** "Step five: Finally, if you have booties, put them on your feet. Make sure they're snug but not too tight. If you have a hood, put it on last. It's important to keep your head warm too!"

**[Cut to Theo putting on booties and a hood]**

**Theo:** "And there you have it! You're all set to hit the water. Remember, practice makes perfect, so don't be discouraged if it takes a few tries to get the hang of it."

**[Closing Scene]**

**Theo:** "Thanks for watching! If you liked this video, give it a thumbs up and subscribe to my channel for more fun tips and tricks. See you next time!"

**[End with Theo giving a thumbs up and a big smile]**

---

This script is designed to be simple and easy to follow, perfect for a young YouTuber like Theo.
